=== include-relative
--- file: diagrams/main.puml
@startuml
!include common/style.iuml
Alice -> Bob : hi
@enduml
--- file: diagrams/common/style.iuml
Bob -> Carol : from diagrams/common/style.iuml
--- dir: diagrams
--- main
!include common/style.iuml
Alice -> Bob : hi
=== include-relative-nested
--- file: a/one.iuml
!include b/two.iuml
one
--- file: a/b/two.iuml
two
--- main
!include a/one.iuml
main
=== include-once-twice
--- file: a.iuml
Alice -> Bob : from a.iuml
--- main
!include_once a.iuml
!include_once a.iuml
=== include-many
--- file: a.iuml
A : a
--- main
!include_many a.iuml
!include_many a.iuml
!include a.iuml
=== include-missing
--- main
Alice -> Bob : hi
!include missing.iuml
=== include-missing-in-included
--- file: a.iuml
first
!include nothere.iuml
--- main
!include a.iuml
=== include-error-in-included
--- file: a.iuml
ok line
!$x = $nofunction()
--- main
before
!include a.iuml
after
=== include-defines-function
--- file: lib.iuml
!function $hello($n)
!return "Hello " + $n
!endfunction
!$libvar = "L"
--- main
!include lib.iuml
A : $hello("you") $libvar
=== include-startuml-first-block
--- file: multi.puml
@startuml
first block
@enduml
@startuml
second block
@enduml
--- main
!include multi.puml
=== include-startuml-block-number
--- file: multi.puml
@startuml
first block
@enduml
@startuml
second block
@enduml
--- main
!include multi.puml!1
!include multi.puml!0
=== include-startuml-block-id
--- file: multi.puml
@startuml(id=one)
first block
@enduml
@startuml(id=two)
second block
@enduml
--- main
!include multi.puml!two
=== include-with-variable
--- file: inc/x.iuml
X : included
--- main
!$dir = "inc"
!include $dir/x.iuml
=== include-yaml-header
--- file: y.iuml
---
title: test
---
Y : after header
--- main
!include y.iuml
=== include-backslash-continuation
--- file: c.iuml
A : one \
two
--- main
!include c.iuml
=== include-uncomment
--- file: c.puml
/' comment
@startuml
' x
A : in comment wrapper
@enduml
'/
--- main
!include c.puml
=== include-subdirectory-relative-again
--- file: lib/a.iuml
!include b.iuml
--- file: lib/b.iuml
B : lib b
--- file: b.iuml
B : root b
--- main
!include lib/a.iuml
!include b.iuml
=== include-absolute-etc
--- main
!include /etc/passwd
=== include-sandbox
--- profile: SANDBOX
--- file: common.iuml
Bob -> Carol : included
--- main
Alice -> Bob : hi
!include common.iuml
=== include-internet-local-denied
--- profile: INTERNET
--- file: common.iuml
Bob -> Carol : included
--- main
!include common.iuml
=== include-allowlist-includepath
--- profile: ALLOWLIST
--- includepath: lib
--- file: lib/common.iuml
C : from include path
--- main
!include common.iuml
=== include-includepath
--- includepath: lib
--- file: lib/common.iuml
C : from include path
--- main
!include common.iuml
=== include-url-sandbox
--- profile: SANDBOX
--- main
!include https://example.com/x.iuml
=== include-url-bad
--- main
!include http://exa mple.com/x.iuml
=== include-directory
--- file: d/x.iuml
x
--- main
!include d
=== include-brackets
--- main
!include [foo]
=== include-stdlib-no-slash
--- main
!include <foo>
=== include-empty
--- main
!include
=== includesub-file
--- file: subs.iuml
@startuml
!startsub PART
P : from part
!endsub
!startsub OTHER
O : other
!endsub
@enduml
--- main
!includesub subs.iuml!PART
=== includesub-file-twice-named
--- file: subs.iuml
!startsub PART
P : one
!endsub
middle
!startsub PART
P : two
!endsub
--- main
!includesub subs.iuml!PART
=== includesub-file-missing-sub
--- file: subs.iuml
!startsub PART
P : one
!endsub
--- main
!includesub subs.iuml!NOPE
=== includesub-file-missing
--- main
!includesub nofile.iuml!PART
=== includedef
--- main
@startdef(id=mydef)
A -> B : from def
@enddef
@startuml
!includedef mydef
@enduml
=== includedef-missing
--- main
!includedef nothing
A : after
=== import-missing
--- main
!import missing.zip
=== import-existing
--- file: lib.zip
not really a zip
--- main
!import lib.zip
A : imported
=== import-directory
--- file: d/x
x
--- main
!import d
=== include-two-levels-error-location
--- file: a.iuml
!include b.iuml
--- file: b.iuml
line b1
!assert 0 : "in b"
--- main
!include a.iuml
=== include-procedure-from-file
--- file: p.iuml
!procedure $p($x)
from p $x
!endprocedure
--- main
!include p.iuml
$p(1)

--- main
!INCLUDE a.iuml

A : a
--- main

=== include-strip-suffix
--- file: a.iuml
A : a
--- main
!include a.iuml!
=== include-theme-missing
--- main
!theme foo
=== include-theme-from-dir

!$themevar = 1
--- main
!theme mine from themes
A : $themevar

---

=== include-theme-from-stdlib
